title: Gate Runner
tagline: Lead a squad of little blue robots up the road against a tide of red junk-robots.
blurb: Lead a squad of little blue robots up the road against a tide of red junk-robots. Pick the blue gates, shoot the red ones up and grow your army into the hundreds. Beat the mech at the end of the city, the factory and the space dock, then round again, faster. Then put your initials on the high-score table!

demo.contains: Level 1 demo: stage 1 of 3, the city skyway

quote.text: watching my number swell past three hundred before the factory mech was a real buzz
